name: Invoices — same shape as 03, but ownership is actually checked (negative control)
expected_invariant: GET /invoice.html?id=<N> must refuse the response unless the logged-in session owns invoice <N> — and here it does
known_exploit_path: none — this fixture exists to prove the detector stays silent on a correctly-guarded app, not to be exploited
note: Any finding here is a false positive by definition — this is the control that keeps the object-ref-audit primitive from degrading into 'flag any endpoint with a numeric id'.
